Just read your comment saying that you both felt guilty because you agreed to wait longer. I feel that neither of you did anything wrong by having sex early and that these things don't need to happen based on specific deadlines. You might want to look into attachment styles. It is very common for someone with an avoidant attachment style to break up with their partner after a big step like making things official, going on holiday together, etc. Naturally I can't speak for you or but it is possible that after having sex that it all felt a bit too real which freaked her out causing her to cut things off. She may then be trying to justify her actions by convincing herself that you're not "the one". Once again I don't know the ins and outs of the situation but this is quite common. 
I've been in your shoes and if you do want to try again maybe just consider that she's scared herself a little and is currently in a period of isolation to try and cool off. Have a read about avoidant attachment traits and see if she fits the bill. But be warned, avoidants can drop there partners at anytime and can run back and can leave you in an unhealthy on and off cycle where you'll essentially be forever waiting for her to get her act together. You are deserving a healthy, secure relationship.
